caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four long, slender legs, and a drop-leaf design, where one side of the table's top is semicircular and hangs down while attached by hinges. The table is primarily brown in color, with darker brown shading to indicate wood grain and depth, and there are lighter brown or beige accents along the edges and details. The left side of the table features a visible curved drawer with a round metal or wooden pull handle. The legs have decorative, vertical inlays in a lighter color, possibly painted to suggest carved or inlaid woodwork, particularly near the upper portions where they join the apron. The table is set against a plain, light beige or off-white background, and there are no additional objects or elements in the composition.
title: Pembroke Table
